# Traitor Job Board
[italic] "You want to make a name for yourself? Well, you can start by planting this bug in the CMO's office for me..." [/italic]
Your [color=#ff0000]employers[/color] have provided you with a job board app hidden inside your uplink.
Each job listing is a mini-objective you can complete for a small reward, like extra telecrystals or sometimes even an uplink item.
The more side jobs you do, the more your reputation within the syndicate will grow, and the tougher and more rewarding your work will be.
Do you think you have what it takes to go down in history as a [color=#ff0000]Living Legend[/color]?
